urls.rationale: Article 1 (General Provisions) — definitions including 'lobbyist' and 'lobbying activity' as used by the State Officials and Employees Ethics Act.
Article 5 (Ethical Conduct) — revolving-door / post-employment lobbying restrictions on state officials and employees.
Article 10 (Gift Ban) — gift prohibitions directly targeting lobbyist-to-official transfers; central lobbying-disclosure adjacent regime.
Article 20 (Executive Ethics Commission and Executive Inspectors General) — enforcement body for executive-branch lobbying violations.
Article 25 (Legislative Ethics Commission and Legislative Inspector General) — enforcement body referenced by 25 ILCS 170 for legislative-branch lobbying violations.
Article 50 (Penalties) — penalty schedule cross-referenced from the lobbying-disclosure violation provisions.

notes: Skipped Article 15 (whistleblower — out of scope), Article 30 (Auditor General), Article 35 (other IGs), Article 70 (governmental entities), Article 75 (transit boards), Articles 90/99 (amendatory / miscellaneous) — not lobbying-disclosure substance.
